full_details: In the morning you cut a second greeting on a roll and did not touch the ending. At two you were in the Two Gentlemen. You did not name the part. At the reckoning John Heminges set your share at twenty-two shillings, a pound and two shillings, in silver. The gown's fifty stayed unpaid. Edith's eight stayed unpaid. The Queen's twenty pounds were not in the room. He did not bring the coffer down. Garnish had a K and no figure, and nobody made one. Margery Pell had no receipt for the Rose's Tasso. Your twopence to the carrier stayed out of the company book. Nothing was bought. At home the twenty-two sat beside Sunday's unsent letter, and the letter stayed unsent.
one_sentence: You played in the gentlemen and took twenty-two shillings at the reckoning.
title: Took twenty-two shillings at the reckoning
